violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW TUNA, SALMON, TILAPIA ON SHELF ABOVE LETTUCE IN #8 1 DR UR, OBSERVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON SHELF ABOVE RTE VEGETABLES IN #1 2 DR LOBBY
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW FISH TO BOTTOM SHELF OF UNIT. CFM MOVED RAW SHELL EGGS ON BOTTOM SHELF OF UNIT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: CREAM CHEESE AT 50F, SALMON, EEL, AND IMITATION CRAB MIX AT 48F IN #6 M3 2 DR RIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM STATED ALL ITEMS PREPARED <2 HOURS AGO, CFM MOVED ALL FOOD ITEMS TO #5 M3 2 DR LEFT.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED PACKAGED OF FROZEN IMITATION CRAB THAWING ON DRAIN BOARD OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO PLACE PACKAGES IN BASIN AND THAW UNDER RUNNING COLD WATER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: #6 M3 2 DR -RIGHT OBSERVED WITH ACCUMULATION OF ICE ON FAN/EVAPORATOR COILS AND AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM REMOVED ICE ON FAN/EVAPORATOR COILS. CFM WILL ADJUST THERMOSTAT TO LOWER SETTING. CFM WILL MONITOR TEMPERATURE OF UNIT. IF UNTIL ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F OR BELOW, TCS FOODS CAN BE STORED IN UNIT. WASABI EXPRESS (Inspection Date: 03/31/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: plastic storage containers and lids at 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CFM reminded employees that all dishware must be washed with soap, rinsed and then sanitized in bleach solution.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed portioned rice in warmer at 80-86F, observed portioned rice on storage rack at 75F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM agreed to reheat portioned rice in warmer in microwave and hot hold at 135F or higher. Portioned rice on storage rack will be cooled down in refrigerator and cold held at 41F or below.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM present during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during inspection. EHS recommended additional staff obtain CFM certificate/renew certificate to ensure a CFM is present during all hours of operation.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed tilapia thawing in packaging in US Refrigerator 1 DR UR.
violations.corrective_action: EHS instructed PIC to cut packaging. ROP fish must have packaging opened prior to thawing in refrigerator.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of shrimp, sushi fish.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS educated PIC that manufacturer containers are not to be reused for storage of foods.
